title: Torah 2 phrase-by-phrase study guide
status: Editorial navigation aid — the sourced Hebrew and English remain unchanged

phrases.en: Speak to the priests
phrases.enMatch: Speak to the priests
phrases.info: The opening command will be reread as prayer and connected to Torah, judgment, the Tzaddik, and purity.

phrases.he: מִנּוּקְבָא דְּפַרְדַּשְׂקָא מָשַׁךְ רוּחָא דְּחַיֵּי לִמְשִׁיחָא
phrases.en: From the nostril is drawn the breath of life to Mashiach
phrases.enMatch: From Nukva DePardaska the breath of life is drawn to Mashiach
phrases.info: The Zoharic source establishes the nose and breath as Mashiach’s channel of vitality.

phrases.he: עִקַּר כְּלֵי זֵינוֹ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ הוּא הַתְּפִלָּה
phrases.en: The basic weapon of Mashiach is prayer
phrases.enMatch: the basic weapon of Mashiach is prayer
phrases.info: Prayer—not physical force—is identified as Mashiach’s essential weapon.

phrases.en: For My praise, I will restrain My anger from you
phrases.enMatch: For My praise, eChToM (I will restrain My anger) from you
phrases.info: The word echtom links praise and prayer with chotem, the nose.

phrases.en: With my sword and my bow
phrases.enMatch: with my sword and my bow
phrases.info: Onkelos and Rashi identify Yaakov’s sword and bow with prayer and supplication.

phrases.en: Guarding the covenant
phrases.enMatch: guarding the brit
phrases.info: The prayer-weapon is received through Yosef’s quality of guarding the covenant.

phrases.en: Prayer is itself twofold
phrases.enMatch: prayer is itself twofold
phrases.info: Prayer contains two mouths or edges: praise of God and the request for one’s needs.

phrases.en: Strike at a hair and not miss
phrases.enMatch: strike at a hair and not miss
phrases.info: The sword of prayer must be aimed precisely, without veering right or left.

phrases.en: Justice is the center pillar
phrases.enMatch: mishpat is the center pillar
phrases.info: Mishpat is the balanced middle line that enables exact prayer.

phrases.en: Through charity
phrases.enMatch: through charity
phrases.info: Charity is the route by which a person takes hold of the quality of judgment.

phrases.en: Donate charity before praying
phrases.enMatch: donate charity before praying
phrases.info: Giving before prayer prepares speech to be directed with judgment.

phrases.en: The main cause of foreign thoughts
phrases.enMatch: the main cause of foreign thoughts
phrases.info: Distracting thoughts in prayer are traced to a corruption of judgment and vision.

phrases.en: For eye to eye they will see
phrases.enMatch: for eye to eye they will see
phrases.info: When judgment is restored, the clouds covering spiritual sight pass away.

phrases.en: Attach himself to the tzaddikim of the generation
phrases.enMatch: attach himself to the true tzaddikim of the generation
phrases.info: Before prayer, a person connects to the true Tzaddikim, each an aspect of Moshe-Mashiach.

phrases.en: All these letters are sparks of souls
phrases.enMatch: all these letters are sparks of souls
phrases.info: Torah’s letters become soul-sparks clothed and renewed within prayer.

phrases.en: The souls clothed in prayer
phrases.enMatch: the souls, when clothed in prayer
phrases.info: Souls clothed in prayer are brought to the Tzaddik of the generation.

phrases.en: The Holy One has hidden His countenance
phrases.enMatch: the Holy One has, as it were, hidden His countenance
phrases.info: The fish parable begins from exile as concealment of the divine face.

phrases.en: That all the prayers are for naught
phrases.enMatch: that all the prayers are for naught
phrases.info: The teaching rejects despair: the Tzaddikim raise every prayer and build the Shekhinah from them.

phrases.he: וּבוֹנִין קוֹמָתָהּ שֶׁל הַשְּׁכִינָה מְעַט מְעַט
phrases.en: Build the structure of the Shekhinah bit by bit
phrases.enMatch: build the structure of the Shekhinah bit by bit
phrases.info: No prayer is lost; each becomes another part of the Shekhinah’s completed structure.

phrases.en: The prayers do not bear fruit
phrases.enMatch: the prayers [are dried out and] do not bear fruit
phrases.info: The apparent dryness of unanswered prayer is explicitly denied as only an appearance.

phrases.en: We are in need of His kindness
phrases.enMatch: we are in need of His kindness
phrases.info: Our prayer and Torah are real work, yet redemption finally depends upon divine kindness.

phrases.en: Speak to the priests suggests prayer
phrases.enMatch: Speak to the priests — EMoR suggests prayer
phrases.info: The conclusion decodes the opening command: emor is the speech of prayer.

phrases.en: He shines into and illuminates the prayer
phrases.enMatch: He yaZHiR (shines) into and illuminates the prayer
phrases.info: The Tzaddik, the great light, illuminates and establishes the small light of prayer.

phrases.en: The sense of smell is mainly dependent upon purity
phrases.enMatch: the sense of smell is mainly dependent upon purity
phrases.info: The final return joins covenantal purity, prayer, and the spiritual sense of smell.
